_comment: UPCOMING RELEASES panel on / (homepage rework, Sep 19 2026). Rendered by tools/build-home.mjs (HOME:releases) and re-filtered client-side by js/home.js so a past date drops off between Monday re-bakes. Hand-curated: only dates read from the named source, never guessed. status = confirmed (a dated line on the maker's calendar) | expected (a window a calendar publishes without a day — shown with its window text, no fake day). href only to a page that exists (build-home refuses otherwise). Keep ~10 upcoming; keep past rows for 30 days (the /release-calendar page shows them under 'Just released' — the 'X release date' searches keep coming for weeks after the date), prune older. `q` = the eBay search for the sealed product (used by tools/build-release-calendar.mjs; falls back to the label); `cat` = eBay category id when not sports cards (183456 = CCG sealed).
